body: MLS audit item 2 is security-correct in source: profile > Verify encryption pushes a normal navigation page; no automatic/pending modal. It displays the exact snapshotted pending MLS safety number or RSA SHA-256 fingerprint and acceptPendingChanges compares both expected bytes against current Keychain pending values before promotion, preventing unseen-key and TOCTOU acceptance. Normal state has no acceptance action. VibeSecureTrust comments reduced to one line. Both Swift files parse clean. Device build remains externally blocked during SwiftPM resolution by sandbox cache permissions; /tmp cache workaround then hit blocked network/sandbox-exec.
